# Supermemory Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that uses Supermemory as long-term memory and document store: add memories or documents (optionally isolated per user or project with a container tag), run hybrid semantic-plus-keyword search, list stored documents, upload files (PDFs, images, video, code), and tune extraction settings. `add`, `upload`, and `settings` are writes — confirmed with you first. Supermemory offers a generous free tier; a self-hosted binary mirrors the same API for those who prefer it. Draft: written from Supermemory's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
